results.title: Misericordia
results.overview: Jérémie returns to his hometown for the funeral of his former boss, the village baker. He decides to stay for a few days with Martine, the man's widow. A mysterious disappearance, a threatening neighbor and a priest with strange intentions make Jérémie's short stay in the village take an unexpected turn.

results.title: Saturday Night
results.overview: At 11:30pm on October 11, 1975, a ferocious troupe of young comedians and writers changed television forever. This is the story of what happened behind the scenes in the 90 minutes leading up to the first broadcast of Saturday Night Live.

results.title: Finding Christmas
results.overview: Following a brutal home invasion on Christmas Eve, 17-year-old aspiring pro gamer Mikey Finnegan is left comatose. His consciousness is then thrust into a surreal journey to ancient Bethlehem. Guided by his Guardian Angel, Mikey must locate the Baby Jesus to secure his path back to his own life.

results.title: Stay Still
results.overview: Hilda and Cristina have been told that a settlement will begin near the cementery. Hilton, an illegal gravedigger, watches with concern. If they invade, he won’t have space to digging graves. The settlement and the cemetery are very close, and the dead seem to have achieved what they desire: a home.

results.title: Madame Durocher
results.overview: The movie follows the life and career of Madame Durocher, first woman to be accepted in the Brazilian Medical Academy.

results.title: DOG HOUSE
results.overview: Frank has finally found somewhere affordable to live, but there’s just one problem. He has to behave.  A short magical realist comedy about loneliness and the rental crisis.

results.title: Air Force One Down
results.overview: On her first assignment aboard Air Force One, a rookie Secret Service agent faces the ultimate test when terrorists hijack the plane, intent on derailing a pivotal energy deal. With the President's life on the line and a global crisis at stake, her bravery and skills are pushed to the limit in a relentless battle that could change the course of history.

results.title: Jailbreak Affair
results.overview: How do inmates in a correctional facility satisfy their sexual desires? A full-fledged confined-space erotic story depicting the precarious prison life of prison guards and inmates involved in sex penpals begins!

results.title: Panda Bear in Africa
results.overview: A young adventurous panda travels from China to Africa to rescue his best friend, Jielong the Dragon, who has been kidnapped. On his journey, he discovers a strange amazing new world of mountains, deserts and jungles.

results.title: The Lockdown
results.overview: Siblings Charlie and Jack are trapped in Myanmar's toughest prison and accused of a crime they didn't commit. Forced into televised fights against other inmates, they must work together and fight for their freedom.

results.title: Thelma the Unicorn
results.overview: Thelma dreams of being a glamorous unicorn. Then in a rare pink and glitter-filled moment of fate, Thelma's wish comes true. She rises to instant international stardom, but at an unexpected cost. After a while, Thelma realizes that she was happier as her ordinary, sparkle-free self. So she ditches her horn, scrubs off her sparkles, and returns home, where her best friend is waiting for her with a hug.

results.title: The Mouse Trap
results.overview: It's Alex's 21st Birthday, but she's stuck at the amusement arcade on a late shift so her friends decide to surprise her, but a masked killer dressed as Mickey Mouse decides to play a game of his own with them which she must survive.

results.title: Crystal Lake
results.overview: A group of friends vacation at a house that's connected to a dark past.

results.title: Beloved Father
results.overview: After years away, Samuel returns to the countryside to care for his ailing father and faces disturbing events that bring to light family traumas and secrets.

results.title: Siblings Team
results.overview: Four siblings Deniz, Derya, Ali and Yaz, who think they've woken up to an ordinary school morning, learn that their parents are actually secret agents. Their parents have been kidnapped by evil forces. With the help of the supercomputer TA-OZ 4000, hidden in their home, the four siblings embark on an adventure to save both their parents and the future of the Earth. On this challenging journey, they will become a true sibling team.

results.title: Amityville Backrooms
results.overview: After visiting a house in Amityville, Keith finds himself suddenly transported to another realm within the home, with no way to get out. Every door he tries leads him back into the very part of the house that he first found himself in. Some theorize the film is a metaphor for dementia.

results.title: Pushpa 2 - The Rule
results.overview: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

results.title: Number 24
results.overview: On the brink of the Second World War, a young Norwegian man's drive to resist the Nazis sets a new course for his future – and the future of his country.

results.title: Mirror Mirror
results.overview: A curator at a high-profile art gallery finds herself drawn to a young, polyamorous artist who introduces her to a lifestyle that reflects a part of herself she had once abandoned.
